All operations that involve network access (like `cargo fetch`) or system modifications are confined within functions and will not run during `--printsrcinfo`. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no security risk.

The package() function installs the built wheel using python-installer and includes the license file. All operations are confined to the build directory and package directory, with no suspicious file manipulations, network calls, or execution of external scripts.

There is no obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or system modifications. The dependencies and tools used are appropriate for a Rust-based Python package. The package follows standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior.
